explanation: The bold hourglass marks the adult female, which is much bigger than the male. Close relatives include Australia's redback, which wears its red stripe on its back.

claims.text: Female black widow spiders have a red hourglass mark on the underside of the abdomen.
Tarantulas, wolf spiders and huntsman spiders do not have a red hourglass mark.
Adult female black widows are much larger than the males.
The Australian redback spider is a close relative of the black widow and has a red stripe on its back.

issues.note: The red hourglass belongs to the American widows. The European 'black widow' (Latrodectus tredecimguttatus) has red spots instead, and Australian players know the redback. With these four options there is still only one answer.
